text.name: TextDesc2
text.text: Pygame is a set of Python modules designed for creating games and multimedia applications. Released in 2000, it provides access to graphics, sound, input devices, and game development tools through the Simple DirectMedia Layer. Pygame has been used for educational projects, independent games, prototypes, and hobby development. Its simple design has made it a popular introduction to programming and game creation.
